versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the word-knowledge-map skill, supporting Knowledge IR-driven hand-drawn infographic posters for English word mapping.
- Defines a step-by-step pipeline from word input to final image, with strict controls on data sources, layout selection, and visual QA.
- Supports multiple layout modes including full-family, phrasal-hub, function-word, and compact-three, all tailored for educational poster use.
- Mandates a hand-drawn "teaching poster" style—cartoon children, thick bent arrows, pastel palette, and prohibits Soft UI or minimal app styles.
- Prioritizes true knowledge (no invented derivatives or usages) and defaults to content for upper primary/middle school readers.
